raw_market.question: Virginia Tech vs. California: 1H Moneyline
raw_market.description:
In the first half of the college football game between Virginia Tech and California, scheduled for October 10 at 3:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Virginia Tech" if Virginia Tech outscore California in the first half.

This market will resolve to "California" if California outscore Virginia Tech in the first half.

If both teams score the same number of points in the first half, this market will resolve 50-50.

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
